user_saw: Imported ChatGPT transcripts lost line breaks, blank lines, code indentation, and repeated spaces in serialized text parts.
summary: The Memory Wiki importer now trims only leading and trailing whitespace from decoded serialized ChatGPT text.
reasoning: PR #182049 replaced regex extraction with JSON parsing and applied `normalizeWhitespace` to the decoded text. The previous extractor already applied the same whitespace-collapsing helper to captured text, so there is no verified working baseline before #182049. The older extractor predates the shallow boundary, and the offline history could not identify its introducing commit.
